products.body:
08B hollow pin roller chain is a 12.70mm pitch metric chain manufactured per ISO and British Standards. The unique design of the hollow pin allows for articles to be affixed to the chain through the hollow pin. 08BHP chain is commonly used in bakeries, packaging, conveyors, elevators, and more. Conforming to ISO standards means that this chain directly interchanges with other brands while also having the ability to operate on standard 08B sprockets; it is essential to note that the inside diameter of our 08B hollow pin is 4.50mm. What sets our 08B hollow pin roller chain apart from others is the use of high-precision components made from superior grades of alloy and carbon steel that have been heat treated and shot peened, with the addition of a factor pre-load done to the chain. The combination of all creates an 08B hollow pin chain that is more capable and has an extended lifespan compared to others. For additional information or a quote on our premium 08B hollow pin chain, contact our customer service team; we will be happy to assist you!

08B Hollow Pin Chain Dimensions


  • Part #: 08BHP
  • Pitch (P): 12.70mm
  • Inside Width (R): 7.75mm
  • Roller Diameter (D): 8.51mm
  • Overall Width (W): 17.00mm
  • Plate Height (H): 11.56mm
  • Hollow Pin I.D. (U): 4.50mm
  • Hollow Pin O.D. (L): 6.28mm
  • Minimum Breaking Load: 1,100 KGS
  • Weight: 0.65 kG/ m

products.body:
Metric 08B stainless steel hollow pin roller chain is manufactured in accordance to ISO 606B, BS228 British, and DIN8187 German manufacturing standards. Our 08BHPSS hollow pin stainless stele roller chain utilizes precision components, a solid roller (seamless) design, and is manufactured from high-quality 304-grade stainless steel. 304SS is a highly anti-corrosive material with a very low magnetic pull, its also capable of operating in very low to very high temperatures without degrading the working and performance capacity of the chain. The hollow pin design makes the chain capable of having attachments fastened through its holes (hollow pins) for conveying and elevating applications.

08BHP Stainless Steel Dimensions


  • Pitch (P): 12.7mm
  • Width Between Inner Plates (b1): 9.5mm
  • Roller Diameter (d1): 8.51mm
  • Pin Diameter (d2): 6.65mm
  • Hollow Pin Inner Diameter (d6): 4mm
  • Pin Length (b4): 19mm
  • Connecting Link Added Width (b7): 1.5mm
  • Total Inner Link Width (b2): 13.8mm
  • Plate Thickness (Ti/ To) 1.7mm
  • Inner Plate Height (h2): 11.8mm
  • Weight: 0.17 kG/ ft
08B stainless steel hollow pin chain is supplied as 10ft boxes that include a connecting link. For additional information or to get a quote please contact us and we will be happy to assist you.
